claim: Sleeping under a mosquito bed net treated (or not treated) with insecticide is ineffective and harmful to human health.

new_qa.question: The World Health Organization recommends the use of insecticide-treated mosquito nets for malaria control and prevention.
new_qa.answer: The search result explicitly confirms that the World Health Organization (WHO) recommends the use of insecticide-treated mosquito nets for malaria prevention, describing them as a "life-saving" and "cost-effective intervention," and it cites evidence from Kenya showing a 44% reduction in child deaths among those protected.
